description: This file contains platform-specific script functions for upgrading firmware images on different hardware devices. It defines functions for checking images, performing upgrades, copying configurations, and includes case statements to handle various device models and their specific upgrade procedures.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Stub function that always returns success, indicating the image is valid.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs device-specific upgrade procedures based on the board name, calling appropriate upgrade functions or scripts.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies device-specific configuration; currently supports copying for on-hub devices.
